name: ENC Digital Technology Co., Ltd
summary: ENC Digital Technology Co., Ltd, based in Shanghai, China, is a provider of cognitive data services within the Chinese market. The company's operations extend to the digital audio-visual sector, encompassing product design, research and development, system integration, and sales, complemented by after-sales installation and commissioning support. Beyond technology, it offers various tourism services, including marine travel itineraries, general recreational packages, reception, and sightseeing excursions. Furthermore, the firm is involved in developing, constructing, and managing facilities aimed at attracting investment and businesses. Established in 2006, it was previously known as Beibu Gulf Tourism Corporation Limited.
